node.statement: Amplification propagation and conclusion: Ruan block estimates give a_{2n}>=a_n/2, standard zero-corner inclusions give a_n>=a_m whenever n<=m, and the assumed a_1>=1/4 together with the dichotomy propagates a_{2^k}>=r_+(e) for every k; hence a_n>=r_+(e)>=1-C_diag*e for every n, which is the asserted estimate.
